metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations by source package (pinned snapshot)
note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: sqlite3
leads.reason: SQLite engine. sqlite3_prepare_v2 compiles statement text into a VDBE bytecode program; the documented C API exposes no syntax tree, so it does not give the AST summary. It is the oracle cross-check in controls/sql/check_controls.py, not a parser path.

leads.name: postgresql-18
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: PostgreSQL server source package; the server parser (raw_parser) is not a documented library API outside the backend. libpg_query is the extracted library form of this grammar.

leads.name: sqlcipher
leads.reason: SQLite fork with encryption; same engine API and no syntax tree, as for sqlite3.

leads.name: libgda5
leads.reason: GNOME Data Access 5 (Debian source libgda5; upstream release 5.2.10 pinned). gda_sql_parser_parse_string with the generic GdaSqlParser returns a GdaStatement whose GdaSqlStatement tree (printed with gda_sql_statement_serialize) gives the oracle summary for both valid controls. The popcon count covers the whole data-access library, not SQL parsing.

leads.name: libpg-query
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: libpg_query: documented pg_query_parse / pg_query_parse_protobuf return the PostgreSQL parse tree (JSON or protobuf) for local text.

leads.name: duckdb
leads.family: DuckDB PEG parser (own grammar since 2.0.0; 1.x used a libpg_query-derived grammar)
leads.reason: C++ library (DuckDB engine); recorded and selected in the C++ cell (duckdb::Parser, DuckDB 2.0.0).

leads.name: mariadb
leads.family: MariaDB server and client source package
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup in the pinned popcon snapshot. Database server and client: the server's SQL grammar (sql/sql_yacc.yy) is compiled into mysqld and is not a documented library API, and the libmariadb client sends statement text to a server. Engine/driver exclusion, as for mysql-defaults and postgresql-18. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 707, 119,017 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: unixodbc
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup. ODBC driver manager: it forwards statement text to the loaded driver and offers no SQL syntax-tree API. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 1,103, 58,128 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: spatialite
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup. Spatial extension library for SQLite; SQL is compiled by the SQLite engine (no public syntax tree), as for sqlite3. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 1,673, 30,735 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: freetds
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup. Client implementation of the TDS wire protocol (db-lib/CT-lib/ODBC); it sends SQL text to a server and has no parser API. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 3,176, 8,190 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: psqlodbc
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup. ODBC driver; its statement scanning for parameter markers and result columns is internal to the driver and not a documented library API returning a statement tree. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 5,697, 1,581 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: mdbtools
leads.family: libmdbsql lex/yacc grammar for Access databases
leads.reason: Round 3 targeted lookup. libmdbsql parses a small SQL subset to query an opened .mdb file: its grammar (src/sql/parser.y at tag v1.0.1) declares SELECT, FROM, WHERE, LIMIT and TOP but no JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY or INSERT, so it cannot parse either control, and its query entry point runs against a database handle. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 8,360, 579 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: tree-sitter-sql
leads.family: tree-sitter-sql grammar on the tree-sitter C runtime
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup in the pinned popcon snapshot (source names starting with 'tree-sitter', outside the first 100 'sql' hits). Debian source tree-sitter-sql 0.3.11-1 (rank 30,115, 8 installations) ships the DerekStride grammar; its only binary is python3-tree-sitter-sql, so the count measures the Python binding. The upstream v0.3.11 release archive's generated src/parser.c and src/scanner.c are byte-identical to the Debian source. With the tree-sitter 0.26.11 C runtime (Debian sid version), ts_parser_parse_string builds a concrete syntax tree (statement, select_expression, relation, join, where, group_by, order_by, invocation, insert, list, literal) that gives the oracle summary for both valid controls.

leads.name: tree-sitter
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup (source names starting with 'tree-sitter'). The tree-sitter incremental parsing runtime ships no grammar; it parses SQL only with the separate tree-sitter-sql grammar, whose path (selected) already pins this runtime (0.26.11) as its dependency. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 2,587, 15,318 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: virtuoso-opensource
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. Database server (SQL and SPARQL); its SQL compiler is internal to the server and has no documented library syntax-tree API. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 7,115, 967 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: cowsql
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. Distributed SQLite engine (a dqlite fork); statements are compiled by SQLite, which exposes no syntax tree. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 7,762, 728 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: dqlite
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. Distributed SQLite engine; statements are compiled by SQLite, which exposes no syntax tree. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 12,130, 209 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: mydumper
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. MySQL backup and restore tool; it splits dump files into statements for loading and has no SQL syntax-tree library API. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 9,871, 382 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: sqliteodbc
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. ODBC driver over SQLite; statement text goes to sqlite3_prepare, no syntax tree. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 12,830, 180 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: pgpool2
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. Connection-pooling middleware that compiles its own copy of the PostgreSQL raw parser (src/parser) into the pgpool server; no library or development package exposes it (libpg_query is the library form of that grammar and is selected). Debian popcon sourcemax rank 19,244, 57 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: tarantool
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup. In-memory database server whose SQL front end is derived from SQLite's and is internal to the server; no library syntax-tree API. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 23,644, 24 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: libcypher-parser
leads.reason: Round-4 targeted lookup (source names containing 'parser'). Parses the Cypher graph query language, not SQL. Debian popcon sourcemax rank 23,974, 22 installations (pinned snapshot).

leads.name: liteparser (sqliteai/liteparser)
leads.reason: Round-4 GitHub discovery (search 'sql parser language:C', 2026-11-18; stars are not used). Apache-2.0 C library, tag 1.0.0, whose README documents an AST with JSON serialization from a Lemon grammar extracted from SQLite parse.y. No Debian source package in the pinned popcon snapshot and no vcpkg or Conan Center port, so it has no admissible metric and was not built. Round 6 (2026-11-18, C/C++ star fallback): 35 GitHub stars, below the 100-star threshold, so it still has no admissible metric and was not built.

leads.name: libinjection
leads.reason: Round-4 GitHub discovery (search 'sql parser language:C'). SQL-injection detector that tokenizes and fingerprints input; no statement tree. No Debian source package in the pinned snapshot. Round 6: client9/libinjection (1,031 stars, tag v3.10.0) and its successor libinjection/libinjection (246 stars, tag v4.0.2) clear the star threshold, but the library returns a token fingerprint and an is-injection verdict, not a statement tree, so the star fallback does not apply.

leads.name: sqlite-createtable-parser (marcobambini/sqlite-createtable-parser)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql parse language:C', 'sqlite parser language:C'; 138 stars, MIT, tag v1.0.0). Schema-only parser: its API parses one CREATE TABLE statement into a table/column/constraint structure and cannot read the SELECT or INSERT control (catalog/sql/PROTOCOL.md excludes schema-only parsers).

leads.name: pg_query_go and pg_query (pganalyze)
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql parser language:C'; 869 and 887 stars). GitHub labels them C because they vendor libpg_query, but they are the Go and Ruby bindings of libpg_query, which is already selected in this cell by Debian popcon; not C libraries of their own.

leads.name: MySQL-Syncer (Terry-Mao/MySQL-Syncer)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql parser language:C', 338 stars). Reads MySQL binlog events and replays them into other stores; it does not parse SQL statement text into a tree.

leads.name: myanon (ppomes/myanon)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql parser language:C', 137 stars). mysqldump anonymizer command-line tool with an internal flex/bison scanner for dump INSERT lines; no documented library API or statement tree.

leads.name: zsv (liquidaty/zsv)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql parser language:C', 416 stars). CSV parser and CLI; the SQL hit is a CLI subcommand that runs queries through SQLite, not an SQL parser.

leads.name: KunlunBase (zettadb/kunlun)
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (copy compiled into the server)
leads.reason: Round-6 GitHub discovery ('sql grammar language:C', 149 stars). Distributed database server with an internal PostgreSQL-derived grammar; no library syntax-tree API.
